name: empty-record
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: An empty record. The joined plan is the plan, with every field of a full plan.

name: other-fields
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Everything else comes back as given, and Only answers come from the record. The record has an account, a start date, a plan reference with another id, outcomes, and unknown fields, and none of them appears. 0090: the record's shape.

name: ada
source: Hand-written. The harness example record. 0090: The tool joins and splits. The plan pre-seeds `team` and the record's answer wins.

name: record-wins
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: The record wins. 0090: The join puts the record's answers over the plan's answers. The record also answers `tracker`, a question the plan gives to the onboarder, and still wins.

name: one-side
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Keys held by one side are kept. 0090: An onboardee answer that the newcomer never gave follows the plan.

name: hidden
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Hidden answers are kept. 0090: An answer for a question the plan no longer declares stays, as a hidden answer. The section `gone` is not in the plan.

name: value-kinds
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: An answer of any kind is laid over. Empty text, an empty list, the flag false, Deferred, and the Text `deferred` all win over what the plan holds. 0035: the three states and the word `deferred`.

name: scopes-are-separate
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Scopes. 0090: A question id is `<scope>.<name>`. The same name in the plan scope and in a section scope are two answers.

name: no-answers-anywhere
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Absent stays absent. A plan with no answers and a record with none give a plan with none.

name: empty-record-maps-add-nothing
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Absent stays absent. A record with an empty plan map and an empty section map gives nothing to the plan.

name: plan-empty-map-stays
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Absent stays absent, and a map the plan holds stays. An empty plan map comes back as an empty map and the missing section map stays missing.

name: empty-plan-maps
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Absent stays absent. The plan's empty maps stay and take the record's answers. A record section with no answers adds no section.

name: plan-answers-only
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Absent stays absent. The record gives only plan answers, so the section map stays missing.

name: section-answers-only
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Absent stays absent. The record gives only section answers, so the plan map stays missing.
